QuestInfo.0: You pinned the Cygnus Knight Emblem to your clothes. All ready to go. Talk to #bChief Alex#k in #bHenesys Ruins#k.
QuestInfo.1: Alex said to reduce the number of knights in the stronghold as a test.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated enemies in the stronghold.

0.0: You'll be able to enter the stronghold now. Go ahead and head in--also I'd be grateful if you could whittle down the number of knights while you are there.

yes.0: Defeat #rOfficial Knight As#k and #rOfficial Knight Bs#k, #r50 each#k. Every soldier counts.

no.0: Are you saying it's impossible, even for you? Then what are the rest of us supposed to do?

yes.0: We confirmed again that infiltration is possible way to strike back at the Knights. Good job.

mob.0: If we wait too long, it won't be a surprise... Go to the stronghold and defeat #b50 each#k of #bOfficial Knight As#k and #bOfficial Knight Bs#k.
